title: relgap outdated --format json
description: The report-v1.json envelope with outdated data: every resolved pin of the project compared with the latest version of its tool, sorted by tool, repo, file and line.

tool.description: The pin's tool, as relgap digest accepts it.

repo.description: GitHub owner/repo of the tool. Absent when the pin was skipped.

current.description: The version the pin stands for.

via.description: How a non-exact pin became current.
enum: highest stable version with this prefix

latest.description: Newest stable version on the tool's release line.

behind.description: Distance from current to latest, counted over the versions of the digest current..latest.

releases.description: Stable versions after current up to latest.

patch.description: Those on current's own minor line.

since.description: When the first of them was published. Absent for tag-only tools.

counts.description: Entries of the digest current..latest at or above the minimum confidence, per kind. Present when the pin was compared.

status.description: current, outdated, unknown (a channel other than latest, or a value no version matches), skipped (no GitHub repository relgap can read) or error.

note.description: Why the pin is unknown, skipped or failed.

eol.description: Reserved for end-of-life data of the current version.

vulns.description: Reserved for known vulnerabilities of the current version.
